== Course of events ==

After Jim kicked Sawhorse in anger during their race, breaking one of its legs and an ear, the wooden creature was left in need of repair. Tin Woodman, whose skill with tools had already been shown in the matter of the duplicate piglet during Eureka's trial, undertook to mend Sawhorse, restoring the broken leg and ear so that the animal could stand and move as before.

With Sawhorse repaired, Princess Ozma bestowed upon it a formal honor, crowning the wooden Sawhorse "Prince of Horses." The Prince and Princess Ozma presided over this recognition, marking Sawhorse's standing among the creatures of the court. Tin Woodman's repair work made the honor possible, since Sawhorse could not have been so honored while still lamed by Jim's kick.
